name: Nemesrempehollós (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, blue at the hoist and white at the fly, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Nemesrempehollós: a crowned white shield with a tower, a raven and a green mound.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
